what: HouseBets House Games limbo: the server's published fairness spec (GET /housegames/limbo/fairness)

body.summary: Every result is HMAC-SHA256 keyed with the server seed, over the message clientSeed:nonce:block — the block is the byte cursor divided by 32, and limbo reads one draw at cursor 0, so its block is 0. The first 4 bytes of that digest, read big-endian, are the draw u (0 to 2^32 - 1), and float = u / 2^32. The result is floor(1e8 / (float x 1e8) x 0.99 x 100) / 100, at least 1.00x and at most 1000000x, and a bet wins when result >= target. This is the standard Limbo formula: any public Limbo calculator given the revealed server seed, the client seed and the nonce prints the same multiplier. A target t is reached with probability 0.99 / t: a 1% edge at every target. The server seed is committed up front by its SHA-256 hash and revealed when you rotate, so a result can never be changed after the fact.
